KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   B. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   C. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

2. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. kitoto
   B. mato
   C. watoto
   D. mitoto

3. When practising Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mahojiano, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mahojiano.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mahojiano.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mahojiano.

1. D — Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

2. C — watoto

3. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kusikiliza na Kujibu Mahojiano.

4. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Sarufi 2.4.1 Viwakilishi vya sifa vya pekee viulizi.

11. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kuandika 1.3.1 Viakifishi.
